description: Zone à Trafic Limité (ZTL) is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Le jeu de données représente le périmètre de la Zone à Trafic Limité (ZTL), mise en œuvre à Paris Centre à compter du 5 novembre 2024 Le périmètre correspond au secteur de Paris Centre (les 1er, 2e, 3e et 4e arrondissements) sans les Grands Boulevards au nord, les îles de la Cité et de Saint-Louis ... Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Mobilité et Espace Public. Its keywords are circulation. The portal shows 1 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
